meta.description: Book a free 30-minute strategy call with Sarovar Marketing Hub, or send us a message and we'll reply within 24 hours.

hero.heading: Let's build something worth talking about
hero.subheading: Tell us where you are and where you want to be. We'll come back with a straight answer on whether we're the right partner — and what we'd do first.

form.heading: Send us a message
form.subheading: The more context you give us, the more useful our first reply will be.
form.successMessage: Thanks for reaching out. A strategist will get back to you within 24 hours — usually much sooner.

map.heading: Find us in Pune

items.question: How fast will I hear back?
items.answer: Within 24 hours on working days, and usually within six. If it's urgent, WhatsApp is the fastest route.

items.question: What happens on the first call?
items.answer: We ask about your business, your numbers and what you've already tried. Then we tell you what we'd do first. No slides, no pressure.

items.question: Do you charge for the audit?
items.answer: The high-level review before our first call is free. A full 30-page written audit is a paid engagement (₹25,000), which we credit back if you sign a retainer.

items.question: Are you taking on new clients right now?
items.answer: We onboard a limited number each quarter to keep quality high. If we're full, we'll tell you when the next slot opens instead of stringing you along.

items.question: Can you work with our in-house team?
items.answer: Often the best setup. We plug in as the strategy and execution layer, or train your team to run what we build. Say so in your message and we'll scope it that way.

cta.heading: Still reading? Let's just talk.
cta.subheading: One short call is worth ten pages of research. Bring your numbers and we'll bring the plan.
